- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:

- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.
- Final message: what you built, test output summary, any types.ts change, anything you could not finish.
- Never start a command in the background or wait for a notification: this session ends when you stop. Run tests and builds in the foreground, then commit.

## F34: Collect all run costs into one file
TASK F34 · Collect all run costs into one file
GOAL: Write reports/costs.json from every report so plans use measured costs only.
OWNS: scripts/costs.ts, tests/costs-script.test.ts
INTERFACE: scripts/costs.ts function collectCosts(files: { path: string; json: unknown }[]): { reviewRuns: number; replayRuns: number; forwardRuns: number; rows: { source: string; setup: string; costUsd: number | null }[] }
BEHAVIOUR: Reads cost fields from replays.json (data[].costUsd with setup), forward.json (data.pairs[] costOld/costNew with the pair's
setups) and review.json (data.setups[].costUsd); counts each kind; unknown files ignored; malformed entries skipped and not counted.

content.text:
I added `collectCosts` in `scripts/costs.ts` and committed it as `85749ed`. I did not run the script, so `reports/costs.json` has not been generated.

- **Reading the reports:** it reads `replays.json` (`data[].costUsd`), `forward.json` (`data.pairs[]` `costOld`/`costNew`) and `review.json` (`data.setups[].costUsd`). Files are matched by file name, and anything else is ignored.
- **Counting:** a forward pair gives up to two rows, one for the old setup and one for the new, so `forwardRuns` counts runs, not pairs.
- **Skipped entries:** an entry is skipped and not counted if its setup name is missing or its cost is not a finite number or `null`. A `null` cost is kept as a row with `costUsd: null`.
- **Running it:** `bun scripts/costs.ts [dir]` walks `reports/` and writes `costs.json` there.
- **Guessed field names:** the repo has no `forward.json` or `replays.json`, so I guessed the setup field names. It accepts `setup`, `setupId` or `setup_id` on replay and review entries, and `setupOld`/`setupNew` or `setup_old`/`setup_new` on forward pairs. If your real files use other names, those entries will be silently skipped, so check this against a real file.
- **Tests:** `tests/costs-script.test.ts` has 2 tests and passes. Typecheck is clean, and the whole suite shows 963 pass, 2 skip, 0 fail.
- **Shared types:** there is no `src/types.ts` change.
- **Unfinished:** nothing else.
